method: Sequentially replace only target source from accepted base using each recorded patch; ninja -j2 target object; objdiff-cli diff -p . -u main/game/game_fn_801028A8 fn_801028A8 -o - --format json -c function_reloc_diffs=name_address. Scores, sections, epilogues and differing instruction row counts below are extracted from each actual JSON output. Restore accepted source after each batch. No compiler flags changed.
hypothesis: Equivalent shared-return control flow can change the scheduler block containing the epilogue. Secondary hypotheses probe type spelling, helper return width, register declarations, lifetime scopes, and nested semantic inline helpers.
conclusion: No improvement. All body-exact variants retain the delayed mtlr. Nested helpers emitted extra out-of-line helper code and larger main symbols and are rejected. Inline marking of the recursive definition omits the externally needed function and is rejected. Best C reconstruction is retained without semantic changes; only its diagnostic comment is updated.
